subject.title: fix: stop selected channel sessions from WebChat

question: Should a public key-only `sessions.abort` call become a destructive full session stop that clears queued successors for all non-global sessions, or should Control UI use an explicit opt-in session-stop contract?
rationale: This is an externally visible Gateway and SDK behavioral contract change with message-delivery and session-lifecycle consequences; source inspection cannot determine which permanent API meaning maintainers want.

options.title: Add an explicit full-session-stop contract
options.body: Preserve existing key-only `sessions.abort` semantics and add a clearly named opt-in method or parameter for Control UI to cancel queued session work.

options.title: Accept key-only destructive semantics
options.body: Keep the current design, document the upgrade behavior prominently, and add compatibility coverage for existing SDK and direct-RPC callers.

options.title: Pause this PR
options.body: Defer the stop-flow change until gateway/session owners settle the public cancellation contract.

recommendation.title: Add an explicit full-session-stop contract
recommendation.body: Preserve existing key-only `sessions.abort` semantics and add a clearly named opt-in method or parameter for Control UI to cancel queued session work.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies this contributor as the author of both related implementations; a gateway/session owner should make the final contract decision.
